name: eggd_purple_plotter
title: PURPLE IGV bars plotter
summary: Generates a self-contained igv.js HTML viewer from PURPLE/AMBER/CNVkit per-sample outputs

inputSpec.name: sample_id
inputSpec.label: Sample ID
inputSpec.help: Sample identifier used in the output filename and HTML header.

inputSpec.name: purple_tar
inputSpec.label: PURPLE tar.gz
inputSpec.help: PURPLE output archive ({sample}.purple.tar.gz) containing AMBER BAF, target-region CN, and segment TSVs. At least one of purple_tar or cnvkit_cnr must be supplied.

inputSpec.name: qc_report
inputSpec.label: QC report TSV
inputSpec.help: QC report TSV ({sample}.qc_report.tsv) containing purity, ploidy, and status columns. If absent, purity and ploidy are shown as '?' in the viewer header.

inputSpec.name: cnvkit_cnr
inputSpec.label: CNVkit CNR
inputSpec.help: CNVkit per-target log2 ratio file ({sample}.cnr). At least one of purple_tar or cnvkit_cnr must be supplied.

inputSpec.name: msi_report
inputSpec.label: MSI report TSV
inputSpec.help: MSI report TSV ({sample}.msi.tsv) containing an msi_score column. If absent, MSI is shown as '?' in the viewer header.

inputSpec.name: locus
inputSpec.label: Initial IGV locus
inputSpec.help: Initial genomic locus displayed when the viewer opens (e.g. chr7:116672196-117120285). Defaults to 'all' (whole genome).

inputSpec.name: genome_image
inputSpec.label: Also output whole-genome PNG/SVG
inputSpec.help: If true, also render the whole-genome view (locus 'all', independent of the locus input) to {sample_id}.genome.png and {sample_id}.genome.svg using headless Chromium from the pp_headless_chromium asset. The image carries a banner with sample ID, purity, ploidy, status and MSI. The job fails if rendering fails.
